name: Neuroflip
summary: Neuroflip is a roguelike memory card game. A run crosses three acts, each a path of battles, elite fights, merchants and treasures that ends in a boss: the Scribe (Jack), the Lady (Queen) and the King. In every stage the player flips cards to find matching pairs before time runs out. Mismatching a card that has never been seen is free, but failing to match a card whose partner has already been seen costs a life. Consecutive matches build a combo that multiplies the score, and cards come in rarities that raise their value. Bosses and elites change the rules of the stage: the Scribe swaps cards around, the Lady veils the table and the King has three crowns to break. Bombs, ghosts, jokers and treasure chests are shuffled into the grid. Between stages the player earns active skills, played by dragging them onto the board, and passive relics, and can buy more from merchants. The game has three difficulty levels, a second deck with its own bosses (the Creatures Deck) unlocked after the first win, a local leaderboard, controller support and 21 languages.
